verdict.rationale: Docs reference a direct HTTP events ingestion API ("Send events directly to mParticle", HTTP API path under /developers/apis/http/) confirming server-to-server ingestion exists, but the evidence pack lacks concrete detail on authentication mechanisms (API keys/secrets) or delivery guarantees (retries, batching, at-least-once semantics) beyond the docs page title. Missing for 10: documented auth flow specifics, explicit delivery/retry guarantees, and independent corroboration of reliability.
